Direct file links (pdf / docx / image / text) are also supported.

files.deleteQueued: Delete task queued; cleanup runs asynchronously
knowledge.title: Knowledge Base
knowledge.maintenanceHint:
After switching the Embedding model, all knowledge chunks must be re-encoded.
The old vector store stays searchable during rebuild.
knowledge.rebuildConfirm:
All knowledge chunks will be re-encoded. The old vector store stays searchable during rebuild.
Continue?
knowledge.resetConfirm: This deletes all documents, chunks, vectors and custom categories, and restores the preset category tree. This cannot be undone. Continue?

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Switch the display language. Takes effect immediately.
settings.appearanceHint: Quality and theme settings. Applied immediately and saved automatically.
settings.themeHint: Custom themes are stored locally on this device; see static/THEMES.md for the authoring guide.
theme.name: Theme name
theme.advancedHint: Advanced: JSON token overrides (optional; keys are design token names and take precedence over the swatches above). Full token list in THEMES.md.
theme.deleteConfirm: Delete this custom theme? This cannot be undone.
theme.invalidJson: Invalid JSON in the advanced token field
settings.modelsHint: Pick a provider on the left, enter its API key on the right, and enable the models you want. One provider shares one API key. Only configured and enabled models appear in the chat window.
settings.selectProviderFirst: Select a provider on the left first
settings.noModelAvailable: No models available for this provider
settings.defaultsHint:
Assign a default model for each role (only configured & enabled models are listed).
If unset, the first configured and enabled model is used.
settings.dataLocationHint:
All app data (conversations, files, parse artifacts, model caches) lives in the data/ folder under the program directory by default.
You can move it elsewhere; existing data is migrated automatically.
settings.sameLocation: The new location is the same as the current one; nothing to migrate.
settings.migrating: Migrating data; you will be notified when done.
settings.migrateDoneSuffix: Restart the app for all paths to take effect.
settings.credentialsHint:
Sensitive credentials (PostgreSQL / MinIO passwords) are stored in credentials.json under the program directory,
never in plaintext in config.yaml, travel with the program folder, and survive restarts.
settings.clearCredentialsConfirm: Clear all credentials (cannot be undone). Continue?
settings.bootstrapHint:
Generates random PostgreSQL / MinIO passwords and writes them to the local credentials file,
updates config.yaml references so services stay connected after restart,
and syncs default models to config.yaml when models are configured.
Note: local PostgreSQL / MinIO services must use the same passwords.
settings.bootstrapConfirm:
The full deployment will run automatically:
  - Discover and start PostgreSQL / Qdrant / MinIO (download if missing)
  - Generate random passwords into the local credentials file
  - Create database user / database / tables
  - Update config.yaml references
  - Sync default model config

This may take 1-3 minutes (MinIO downloads on first run).
Do not close the app. Continue?
settings.bootstrapRunning: A deployment task is already running; please wait.
settings.bootstrapDoneSuffix: See the log above. The app is ready to use without restart.
settings.selectComponentFirst: Check at least one component first
settings.scheme.saved: Saved: VLM={vlm}, Embedding={emb} (takes effect after restart)

settings.computeHint:
Choose the device for local models (Embedding / VLM).
Auto picks the GPU with the most VRAM; you can also pin a specific GPU or use CPU only.
Takes effect after restart.
settings.compute.autoNoGpu: Auto (no GPU detected, will use CPU)
settings.compute.savedToast: Compute device saved; takes effect after restart.
